rca of the issue: BUG1 root cause (production dialer routing to main line) is CONFIRMED FIXED at two layers: (1) /api/twilio/twiml — direction-aware routing guard (line 407) only <Dial>s when From starts with 'client:' (SDK-outbound); any other Direction/From (including a Twilio-fallback retry with no custom To) is greeted+hung up with no <Dial>. (2) /api/twilio/twiml-fallback — a brand-new SAFE endpoint the user will configure as the Twilio Console Fallback URL; it can NEVER produce a <Dial> tag (grep-proof) and never mentions the main line number. (3) _verify_twilio_signature is now LENIENT — missing X-Twilio-Signature header is admitted with a warning log instead of returning 403 (which was the actual regression cause because the K8s ingress rewrites the URL and the signature validation fails, then Twilio falls back to the misconfigured Fallback URL). Verified: live curl to preview /twiml with no signature header + client:agent-* From + valid To → 200 with <Dial callerId=+14506343099><Number>+15145551234</Number></Dial>; live curl self-dial → 400; live curl inbound → Say+Hangup with no <Dial>; live curl /twiml-fallback (POST and GET) → 200 bilingual Say+Hangup, no <Dial>. Mitigation shipped; user still needs to POINT the Twilio Console Voice URL Fallback at /api/twilio/twiml-fallback to close the loop.
